ideas.idea: Add directions/address text to the visit page to match its meta description
ideas.why: The visit page body lacks directions despite the description promising them, so adding text helps people and machines.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness structured data for hours and location on the visit page
ideas.why: Accurate but optional, and JSON-LD absence is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: List named varieties or add per-variety pages to back up the 'over forty' claim
ideas.why: The varieties page names only two varieties, so a list gives a concrete answer to a likely query.

ideas.idea: Extend robots.txt to block more training crawlers beyond GPTBot and ClaudeBot
ideas.why: The config says trainingCrawlers block but robots.txt names only two bots, so other training crawlers are still allowed.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap.xml entries
ideas.why: Accurate since no lastmod is present, but it applies to almost any site and has a small effect.

ideas.idea: Add in-text links from the home page to varieties and visit pages
ideas.why: The home page is very short and already links via the nav, so the benefit is small.
